items.title: What Runs Where? Local AI in Production — Ahmad Osman, Osmantic
items.content_snippet: A capable local model still needs the right hardware, inference engine and tools. At CODE Summit 2026, Osmantic founder Ahmad Osman explains how to choose that stack for real workloads, covering quantization, memory bandwidth, batching and specialized models. He connects local AI performance to agent harnesses, evaluation traces and the economics of owning GPUs, then makes the case for continual learning on machines you control. Speaker info: - https://ahmadosman.com/ - https://github.com/theahm
